description: See how Anime Cabinet turns a couple photo into a hand-drawn anime portrait. Explore the process, photo tips, style options, 72-hour previews, and free revisions.
intro:
A great couple photo already contains the most important ingredients for a memorable portrait: your expressions, body language, outfits, and the small details that make the moment yours. The transformation begins when a human artist studies those details and redraws them as original anime-inspired characters. This is not an AI filter or an instant photo effect. It is a hand-drawn custom anime portrait created around your relationship and the feeling of the reference image.

In this walkthrough, we follow the journey from an everyday photograph to a finished couple portrait. Anime Cabinet offers 24 anime and cartoon-inspired styles, from energetic action influences to softer storybook looks. You can request a visual direction inspired by a favourite series, but the finished artwork presents you as original characters rather than impersonating copyrighted characters. You receive a preview within 72 hours as standard, plus unlimited free revisions so the final piece feels right.

blocks.text: Couple photos rarely arrive perfectly composed for anime art. Our artists extract what matters — faces, expressions, relative height, body language — and rebuild the scene in the chosen style. A cramped bar photo becomes a [Jujutsu Kaisen](/portraits/jujutsu-kaisen) back-to-back composition. A park bench shot becomes a [Ghibli-style](/portraits/ghibli-style) meadow scene.

sections.heading: What to include in your order

blocks.text: Upload the best couple photo you have — clear faces beat perfect lighting. Describe your dynamic in the notes: who stands where, favourite shared show, any props or backgrounds you want. [Ghibli-style](/portraits/ghibli-style), [Jujutsu Kaisen](/portraits/jujutsu-kaisen), and [The Simpsons](/portraits/the-simpsons) couch scenes are popular starting points. Approve the preview together if it's a gift. The transformation is collaborative; the result is permanent.

Couple photo to anime portrait orders work best when you treat the notes field like a brief, not an afterthought. Height differences, who leans on whom, favourite episodes, inside jokes — those details separate a template from a portrait that feels like your relationship.

Do we both need to be in one photo? One couple photo is ideal, but separate images can work if faces are clear — mention who is who in the notes. Can we approve together if it is a surprise? Yes — many gift-givers approve solo; couples often approve on a video call for shared reactions.

Standard preview delivery is within seventy-two hours with unlimited revisions. Order at least a week before anniversaries or visits. A couple anime portrait transformation is one of the highest-impact gifts we produce — because the source photo is ordinary and the result is anything but.
